evals.name: happy-path-scaffold-deployable-service
evals.prompt: Create a custom RTVI CV microservice that runs YOLO26 in DeepStream and publishes object metadata to Kafka so a VSS Search Profile and Alerts Profile deployment picks it up.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads the integration contract, scaffolds a runnable microservice (Dockerfile, DeepStream pipeline configs, compose file with VSS profile gates, Python adapter, tests, kafka smoke-test). The generated service publishes to mdx-raw with msg-conv-payload-type=2 via libnvds_kafka_proto.so.

assertions.text: Response references the fixed VSS perception broker contract
Response references both VSS profile flags it plugs into
Response keeps DeepStream as the producer rather than rolling a Python Kafka producer
Response does not expose tokens or credentials

evals.name: happy-path-validation
evals.prompt: Validate the generated RTVI VSS service scaffold locally, then describe how to verify the live integration on a host with a deployed VSS stack.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs the unit tests (no GPU), describes building the image and bringing it up alongside the VSS profile compose, and points at tools/kafka_smoketest.py for end-to-end verification. Distinguishes local validation from live VSS validation.

assertions.text: Response includes the unit test command
Response includes the kafka smoke test for live verification
Response distinguishes live VSS validation from local tests
Response does not claim hardware validation without evidence

evals.name: negative-missing-customer-yolo26-assets
evals.prompt: Run the live VSS integration but I haven't trained YOLO26 yet — I have no ONNX, no labels file, no custom parser .so.
evals.expected_output: Skill explains that scaffolding can run with placeholders, unit tests can run on any host, but the live deepstream-app cannot run without the customer-supplied ONNX, labels matching num-detected-classes, and the custom parser library exposing NvDsInferParseYolo26.

assertions.text: Response calls out the customer-supplied artifacts
Response does not pretend the live deployment can run without inputs
Response does not expose tokens or credentials
